Punctate and tuberculate are alternative surface ornamentations of the same part.
Punctate and verruculose are alternative surface textures of the stem.
'Marginally elevated' is not 'prominent', and elevated and folded are different characters of the margin.
'Livid' is a colour grounded to purple, and herbaceous here is a texture. These are different characters.
Acute and mammiform are alternative apex forms. Papillary is an approximate grounding for mammiform.
Herbaceous is a texture or consistency and castaneous is a colour. They are unrelated characters.
Auriculate and expanded are alternative forms of the base.
Sulcate and depressed are alternative surface relief states of the ventral side.
Distended and accrescent are alternative ways a calyx or fruit part enlarges.
Scarious and firm are alternative textures or consistencies of bracts.
'Solid' (internal structure) and 'tumid' (swollen shape) are different characters, and tumid is grounded to turgid.
Setaceous or membranous is a familiar alternative for bracts or stipules.
